body.translated_text:
Svayambhu Purāṇa
First Chapter
The origin story of the arising of <s>Svayambhū Dharmadhātu</s>

body.text: om namaḥ śrī dharmadhātuvāgīśvarāya sarva buddhadharmabodhisattvebhyaḥ /
body.translated_text: Oṃ, salutation to the glorious <s>Dharmadhātu Vāgīśvara</s>, to all <s>Buddhas</s>, <s>Dharma</s>, and <s>Bodhisattvas</s>.

children.translated_text: By whom the glorious true <s>Dharma</s> was illuminated in the three worlds,

children.text: śrīghanaṃ taṃ mahābuddhaṃ vandeka'haṃ śaraṇāśritaḥ // SvayambhuP_1.1 //
children.translated_text: that great <s>Buddha</s>, a mass of splendor—I, having taken refuge, bow to him. // SvayambhuP_1.1 //
Having bowed to the Lord of the three worlds, the abode of the <s>Jina</s> (victor), the <s>Dharmadhātu</s>,
I shall narrate the account of that <s>Svayambhū</s>; listen with reverence. // SvayambhuP_1.2 //
He who hears with faith this excellent tale of the arising of <s>Svayambhū</s>,

children.text: pariśuddhatrikāyāḥ sa bodhisattvo bhaved dhruvaṃ // SvayambhuP_1.3 //
children.translated_text: with his three bodies purified, shall surely become a <s>Bodhisattva</s>. // SvayambhuP_1.3 //
Thus, long ago, there was one endowed with knowledge of former births, <s>Jayaśrī</s>, son of the <s>Sugata</s> (the Well-gone One);
he dwelt in the <s>Bodhimaṇḍa Vihāra</s> (monastery of the seat of enlightenment), together with his community. // SvayambhuP_1.4 //
There was a <s>Bodhisattva</s> of great wisdom named <s>Jineśvara</s>,

children.text: śraddhayā śaraṇaṃ gatvā jayaśrīyaṃ upāśrayet // SvayambhuP_1.5 //
children.translated_text: who, with faith, having gone for refuge, had attended upon <s>Jayaśrī</s>. // SvayambhuP_1.5 //
Then the wise <s>Jayaśrī</s>, knowing the welfare of all beings,
in order to teach the true <s>Dharma</s>, took his seat in the assembly. // SvayambhuP_1.6 //
There all the great beings, <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, sons of the <s>Jina</s>,
<s>Arhats</s> (worthy ones), <s>Bhikṣus</s> (monks), <s>Brahmacārins</s> (celibate practitioners), and <s>Śrāvakas</s> (hearers), // SvayambhuP_1.7 //
<s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s> (nuns), female <s>Brahmacārins</s>, those observing vows, and <s>Upāsakas</s> (lay male devotees),
<s>Upāsikās</s> (lay female devotees), and other householders and great people, // SvayambhuP_1.8 //
<s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, <s>Tīrthikas</s> (adherents of other paths), ascetics and those performing austerities,
kings, ministers, counselors, army commanders, and citizens, // SvayambhuP_1.9 //
villagers, people of the countryside, and inhabitants of other places—
all had come with faith to drink the nectar of the true <s>Dharma</s>. // SvayambhuP_1.10 //
There, seated in the assembly, they venerated that worthy <s>Jayaśrī</s>,

children.text: abhyarcya sādaraṃ natvā tatsabhāyāṃ yathākramaṃ // SvayambhuP_1.11 //
children.translated_text: worshipping him with reverence and bowing in proper order in that assembly. // SvayambhuP_1.11 //
All, with palms joined in añjali, having circumambulated from all sides,
placing him before them and gazing upward, they sat down in concentration. // SvayambhuP_1.12 //
Seeing all those seated ones, eager to hear the true <s>Dharma</s>,
the <s>Bodhisattva</s> <s>Jinaśrī</s> arose. // SvayambhuP_1.13 //
Throwing his upper garment over one shoulder, with palms joined in respect,
placing both knees on the ground and gazing, he spoke thus: // SvayambhuP_1.14 //
"Venerable one, I desire to undertake the <s>Bodhisaṃvara</s> (vow of enlightenment);

children.text: tadādau kiṃ vrataṃ dhṛtvā saṃcareya samāhitaḥ // SvayambhuP_1.15 //
children.translated_text: at the outset, holding what vow should I practice with concentration? // SvayambhuP_1.15 //
May you instruct us all, awakening us,
and joining us on the path of enlightenment, deign to guide us in meritorious conduct." // SvayambhuP_1.16 //

children.text: iti saṃprārthitaṃ tena śrutvā ca sugatātmajaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard this entreaty by him, the son of the <s>Sugata</s>,
<s>Jayaśrī</s>, addressed that great being and the assembly thus: // SvayambhuP_1.17 //

children.text: śṛṇu vatsāsti te vāṃchā sambodhisaṃvare yadi /
children.translated_text: "Listen, dear child, if your desire is for the vow of perfect enlightenment,
I shall expound in proper order the means of accomplishing the vow of <s>Saṃbodhi</s> (perfect enlightenment). // SvayambhuP_1.18 //

children.text: yo vāṃchā tatra saṃsāre carituṃ bodhisaṃvaraṃ /
children.translated_text: He who desires to undertake the <s>Bodhisaṃvara</s> (vow of enlightenment) in this <s>Saṃsāra</s> (cycle of existence),

children.text: sa ādau śaraṇaṃ gatvā sadguruṃ samupāśrayeta // SvayambhuP_1.19 //
children.translated_text: should first go for refuge and attend upon a true <s>Guru</s> (teacher). // SvayambhuP_1.19 //

body.translated_text: Having received his instruction, one should be concentrated according to the rules. // SvayambhuP_1.20 //

children.translated_text: Having bathed at a <s>Tīrtha</s> (sacred ford), with a purified self, having gone for refuge in the Three Jewels,
having worshipped according to the rites, with one's mind set on enlightenment, // SvayambhuP_1.21 //
one should observe the <s>Upoṣadha</s> (fasting) vow and act for the welfare of the world.

children.text: evaṃ yaścarate nityaṃ saṃbodhimānasaḥ sudhīḥ // SvayambhuP_1.22 //
children.translated_text: Thus, the wise one who constantly practices with a mind set on enlightenment, // SvayambhuP_1.22 //
with his three bodies purified, shall become a <s>Bodhisattva</s>.
The <s>Bodhisattva</s>, a great being, bears the welfare of all beings. // SvayambhuP_1.23 //
He should gradually, with concentration, complete the accumulation of <s>Saṃbodhi</s> (perfect enlightenment);
with his mind devoted to this merit, maintaining the four <s>Brahmavihāras</s> (divine abodes), // SvayambhuP_1.24 //

body.translated_text: free from afflictions, conquering <s>Māra</s> (the tempter), he shall attain perfect enlightenment. // SvayambhuP_1.25 //

children.translated_text: Thus, illuminating the true <s>Dharma</s> in all worlds,
having completed the work of the <s>Sugata</s>, he shall attain supreme <s>Nirvṛti</s> (bliss). // SvayambhuP_1.26 //
Then, having become an <s>Arhat</s>, a <s>Sugata</s>, awakening all beings,
establishing them on the path of enlightenment, he should guide them in conventional practice. // SvayambhuP_1.27 //
Thus, all <s>Saṃbuddhas</s> (fully awakened ones), past and future,

children.text: varttamānāśca te hayetad vratapuṇya vipākataḥ // SvayambhuP_1.28 //
children.translated_text: as well as those of the present—all these, through the fruition of vow and merit, // SvayambhuP_1.28 //
having attained enlightenment, were <s>Jinas</s> (victors), shall be, and are;

children.text: evaṃ sarve mahāsattvā bodhisattvā jinātmajāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.29 //
children.translated_text: likewise, all the great beings, <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, sons of the <s>Jina</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.29 //
and all the <s>Arhats</s>, with their three spheres purified,

children.text: bodhiṃ prāpya sunirvāṇaṃ yātā yāsyanti yāntyataḥ // SvayambhuP_1.30 //
children.translated_text: having attained enlightenment and supreme <s>Nirvāṇa</s>, have gone, shall go, and go. // SvayambhuP_1.30 //
Thus, knowing this, if you desire supreme bliss,
having gone for refuge in the Three Jewels, practice this vow!" // SvayambhuP_1.31 //

children.text: iti tena samādiṣṭaṃ śrutvā sa sugatātmajaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard what was thus instructed by him, that son of the <s>Sugata</s>,
gazing upon <s>Jineśvara</s>, that worthy one, spoke thus: // SvayambhuP_1.32 //
"Venerable one, I wish to hear about that supreme place of the vow;

children.text: etad vrataṃ caretkutra taddeśaṃ samupādiśat // SvayambhuP_1.33 //
children.translated_text: where should one practice this vow? Please instruct about that place." // SvayambhuP_1.33 //

children.text: iti saṃprārthite tena jayaśrīḥ sa mahāmatiḥ /
children.translated_text: When thus entreated by him, <s>Jayaśrī</s>, the great-minded one,
looking at the great being <s>Jineśvara</s>, instructed thus: // SvayambhuP_1.34 //
"Listen, dear child, with concentration, about the supreme place of the vow;
as declared by the great <s>Munis</s> (sages), so I shall tell you now. // SvayambhuP_1.35 //

body.translated_text: In fields of merit, at sacred <s>Tīrthas</s>, in monasteries, in hermitages of the <s>Sugata</s>,

body.text: buddhānāṃ nivṛtānāṃca caityeṣu pratimāsu ca // SvayambhuP_1.36 //
body.translated_text: at <s>Caityas</s> (shrines) and images of departed <s>Buddhas</s>— // SvayambhuP_1.36 //

children.translated_text: in all <s>Buddhakṣetras</s> (Buddha-fields), these are the supreme places of the vow;
among these, the <s>Svayambhū Caitya</s> has been declared supreme. // SvayambhuP_1.37 //
Thus knowing, the wise one who desires to practice the vow,

children.text: sa svayambhū jinakṣetraṃ āśritya caratāṃ vrataṃ // SvayambhuP_1.38 //
children.translated_text: should resort to the <s>Svayambhū Jinakṣetra</s> (field of the self-arisen victor) and practice the vow there. // SvayambhuP_1.38 //
He who, resorting to the <s>Svayambhū Kṣetra</s> (field), joyfully practices the vow,

children.text: sa labhet tanmahat puṇyamakṣayaṃ bodhisādhanaṃ // SvayambhuP_1.39 //
children.translated_text: shall obtain that great, inexhaustible merit, the means to enlightenment. // SvayambhuP_1.39 //
By this merit, the pure-souled <s>Bhadraśrī</s>, abode of good qualities,
a <s>Bodhisattva</s> of great supernatural knowledge, shall surely become a son of the <s>Jina</s>. // SvayambhuP_1.40 //

children.text: durgatiṃ na brajet kvāpi saṃsāre sa kadācana /
children.translated_text: He shall never go to any evil destiny in <s>Saṃsāra</s> (cycle of existence),
always born in good destinies, he shall practice the <s>Bodhicaryā</s> (conduct of enlightenment) vow. // SvayambhuP_1.41 //

children.text: evaṃ sa saṃsaralloke kṛtvā sarvatra bhadratā /
children.translated_text: Thus, wandering in the world, having performed virtue everywhere,

children.text: saṃbodhi praṇidhiṃ dhṛtvā saṃcare tadjagaddhite // SvayambhuP_1.42 //
children.translated_text: holding the aspiration for enlightenment, he shall act for the welfare of the world. // SvayambhuP_1.42 //

children.text: evaṃ ca bodhi saṃbhāraṃ pūrayitvā yathākramaṃ /
children.translated_text: And thus, having fulfilled the accumulation of enlightenment in proper order,
attaining the threefold enlightenment, he shall reach the state of <s>Nirvṛti</s> (bliss). // SvayambhuP_1.43 //
Thus, knowing this, having resorted to the place of <s>Svayambhū</s>,
having gone for refuge in the Three Jewels, practice the supreme vow!" // SvayambhuP_1.44 //
Having heard what was thus instructed by the <s>Arhat</s>, that son of the <s>Sugata</s>,
gazing at that worthy <s>Jayaśrī</s>, spoke thus: // SvayambhuP_1.45 //

children.text: bhadanta bhavatā diṣṭaṃ śrutvā me rocate manaḥ /
children.translated_text: "Venerable one, having heard what you have instructed, my mind is delighted;
I have become disposed to practice the vow by worshipping the <s>Svayambhū Caitya</s>. // SvayambhuP_1.46 //
The <s>Svayambhū Caitya</s>, the king of shrines, glorious <s>Dharmadhātu</s>, abode of the <s>Jina</s>—
where does it exist in this earthly world? Please instruct about that." // SvayambhuP_1.47 //

children.text: iti saprārthitaṃ tena śrutvāṃ so 'rhan yatiḥ sudhīḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard this entreaty by him, that worthy ascetic, the wise one,
<s>Jayaśrī</s>, looking at that great being, instructed thus: // SvayambhuP_1.48 //
"It exists in this earthly world, in the northern <s>Himālaya</s>,
in the land renowned as <s>Nepāla</s>, on the excellent mountain called <s>Gopuccha</s> (cow's tail). // SvayambhuP_1.49 //
That mountain's name changes in the four <s>Yugas</s> (ages);
in the <s>Satya Yuga</s> (age of truth), it was known as <s>Padmagiri</s> (Lotus Mountain). // SvayambhuP_1.50 //
In <s>Tretā</s> (the second age), it was called <s>Vajrakūṭa</s> (Diamond Peak); in <s>Dvāpara</s> (the third age), it was known as <s>Gośṛṅga</s> (Cow's Horn);

children.text: idānīṃ tu kalau 'sau gopuccha iti viśrutaḥ // SvayambhuP_1.51 //
children.translated_text: and now, in <s>Kali</s> (the present age), it is renowned as <s>Gopuccha</s> (Cow's Tail). // SvayambhuP_1.51 //
That same mountain now, by the people of the land of <s>Nepāla</s>,
is known as <s>Sāmheguri</s>, and thus it stands on earth. // SvayambhuP_1.52 //
It is supreme, composed of all minerals and all precious substances,
adorned with <s>Aśvattha</s> (sacred fig) and other trees of all kinds. // SvayambhuP_1.53 //
Beautiful everywhere with flowers, with trees bearing all herbs and fruits,
resounding with the calls of all birds and the humming of roaming bees, // SvayambhuP_1.54 //
inhabited by creatures with minds bound in friendship and affection,
frequented by those of virtuous conduct, like ascetics. // SvayambhuP_1.55 //
Adorned with pure, nectar-like streams endowed with the eight qualities,
beautified by breezes perfumed with the fragrance of flowers. // SvayambhuP_1.56 //
Always frequented and celebrated with divine great festivities,
constantly attended with reverence by the lords of all worlds. // SvayambhuP_1.57 //
There, on the pericarp of a jeweled lotus, resting upon it,
resplendent like a divine crystal gem, luminous, immaculate, // SvayambhuP_1.58 //
one cubit in height, in the form of a <s>Caitya</s> (shrine), the abode of the <s>Jina</s>,
the self-arisen <s>Svayambhū</s> stands for the welfare of all worlds. // SvayambhuP_1.59 //
By <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Śakra</s> (Indra), and other gods, by all the lords of the worlds,
by all the lords of demons, by <s>Nāgendras</s> (serpent kings) and <s>Garuḍas</s> (divine eagles), // SvayambhuP_1.60 //
by <s>Siddhas</s> (perfected ones), <s>Vidyādharas</s> (knowledge-holders), <s>Sādhyas</s>, <s>Yakṣas</s>, <s>Gandharvas</s>, and <s>Kinnaras</s>,
by lords of <s>Rākṣasas</s> (demons) and <s>Rudras</s>, by planets and hosts of stars, // SvayambhuP_1.61 //
by <s>Vasus</s> and <s>Apsaras</s> (celestial nymphs), by all the lords of the thirty gods,
by <s>Ṛṣis</s> (seers), ascetics, all <s>Yogins</s>, and <s>Brahmacārins</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.62 //
by all <s>Tīrthikas</s> (adherents of sacred fords), the wise, <s>Tāpasas</s> (ascetics), and virtuous people—

children.text: divāniśaṃ catuḥ saṃdhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā smṛtvā pravanditaḥ // SvayambhuP_1.63 //
children.translated_text: day and night, at the four junctions of the day, having seen and remembered, he is worshipped. // SvayambhuP_1.63 //
They come at all times, worship him with reverence,
and he is honored and venerated with praises and great celebrations. // SvayambhuP_1.64 //
Thus, that Lord of the three worlds, <s>Svayambhū</s>, the <s>Dharmadhātu</s>,
stands illuminating for the welfare of all beings. // SvayambhuP_1.65 //

children.text: idānīntu kalau lokā duṣṭāḥ krūrāśayā śaṭhāḥ /
children.translated_text: But now, in the <s>Kali</s> (age of strife), people are corrupted, cruel-minded, and deceitful;

children.text: dṛṣṭavedaṃ dharmadhātuṃ hi hariṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ // SvayambhuP_1.66 //
children.translated_text: having seen this <s>Dharmadhātu</s>, they will surely steal it. // SvayambhuP_1.66 //
Therefore, having covered it with stone, it was concealed and yet revealed;
and above it, having constructed a supreme <s>Caitya</s> (stūpa), // SvayambhuP_1.67 //
having adorned it with parasols, banners, and flags, it was consecrated.
There too, by all the people of the world and by all the lords of the worlds, // SvayambhuP_1.68 //
having assembled and worshipped, having venerated and honored,
with offerings and great celebrations, with praises, circumambulations, and the like, // SvayambhuP_1.69 //
with prostrations and worship, he is served, honored, and venerated.

children.text: evaṃ sa trijagannātho dharmadhātu jinālayaḥ // SvayambhuP_1.70 //
children.translated_text: Thus, that Lord of the three worlds, the <s>Dharmadhātu</s>, the abode of the <s>Jina</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.70 //
stands beautified for the auspicious welfare of all beings.

children.text: tatra ye śaraṇaṃ gatvā yānti śuddhayā mudā // SvayambhuP_1.71 //
children.translated_text: Those who, having taken refuge there, go with pure joy, // SvayambhuP_1.71 //

children.text: durggatiṃ te na gachanti saṃsāre 'tra kadācana /
children.translated_text: they never fall into misfortune in this <s>saṃsāra</s> (cycle of existence);
born in good destinies, endowed with <s>dharma</s>-glory, adorned by the <s>saṃgha</s>. // SvayambhuP_1.72 //
<s>Bodhisattvas</s>, great beings, with the three spheres completely purified,
endowed with auspicious glory, bearing good qualities, benefactors of all beings, // SvayambhuP_1.73 //
having undertaken the vow of <s>bodhicaryā</s> (conduct toward enlightenment), they wander for the welfare of the world;

children.text: evaṃ yūyamapi jñātvā śraddhayā śaraṇa gatāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.74 //
children.translated_text: thus, you too, having understood, go to refuge with faith. // SvayambhuP_1.74 //
Having worshipped the <s>Svayambhū</s> <s>caitya</s> (self-arisen shrine), always practice the vow;

children.text: evaṃ kṛtvātra saṃsāre bhadraśrī sadguṇāśrayā // SvayambhuP_1.75 //
children.translated_text: having done thus in this <s>saṃsāra</s>, with auspicious glory and a repository of good qualities, // SvayambhuP_1.75 //
you shall become <s>bodhisattvas</s>, great beings, sons of the <s>Jina</s> (Victorious One);
then, having fulfilled the accumulations for <s>saṃbodhi</s> (perfect enlightenment) in due order, // SvayambhuP_1.76 //
having attained the threefold <s>bodhi</s> (enlightenment), you shall reach the state of a <s>Saṃbuddha</s> (Fully Awakened One);

children.text: iti tena samādiṣṭaṃ niśaṃmya sa mahāmatiḥ // SvayambhuP_1.77 //
children.translated_text: having heard what was thus instructed by him, that great-minded one, // SvayambhuP_1.77 //
looking at that teacher, spoke again thus:
"Venerable one, I wish to hear about how the <s>Svayambhū</s> (Self-Arisen) shrine of the <s>Jina</s> // SvayambhuP_1.78 //

children.text: kadā svayaṃ samutpannaḥ kathaṃ ca tadupādiśa /
children.translated_text: arose by itself, and when — please explain that."

children.text: iti saṃprārthita tena śrutvā so 'rhan yatiḥ sudhīḥ // SvayambhuP_1.79 //
children.translated_text: Having heard this request from him, that <s>arhat</s> (worthy one), the wise ascetic, // SvayambhuP_1.79 //
<s>Jayaśrī</s>, looking at that great being, instructed thus:

children.text: sādhu śṛṇu mahābhāga yathā mayā śrutaṃ guroḥ // SvayambhuP_1.80 //
children.translated_text: "Well said! Listen, O greatly fortunate one, as I heard from my <s>guru</s> (teacher), // SvayambhuP_1.80 //
so I shall narrate to you the sacred story of the arising of <s>Svayambhū</s>."
"In the city of <s>Pāṭalīputra</s>, <s>Aśoka</s> was the lord of men, // SvayambhuP_1.81 //
zealous in the practice of the true <s>dharma</s>, a devotee of the <s>Triratna</s> (Three Jewels);

children.text: sa tatra kukkuṭārāme vihāre sugatāśrame // SvayambhuP_1.82 //
children.translated_text: there, in the <s>Kukkuṭārāma</s> monastery, the hermitage of the <s>Sugata</s> (Well-Gone One), // SvayambhuP_1.82 //
he approached to pay homage to <s>Upagupta</s>, the one of great supernatural knowledge;
then that <s>arhat</s> of great supernatural knowledge, attended by the entire <s>saṃgha</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.83 //
was seated on the throne in the assembly hall, composed in meditation;
seeing that <s>arhat</s> seated in the assembly, attended by the entire <s>saṃgha</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.84 //
<s>Aśoka</s>, that lord of the earth, joyfully approached;

children.text: tatra sa sahasopetya sāñjalirarhato yatīn // SvayambhuP_1.85 //
children.translated_text: there, having quickly come forward, with joined palms, to the <s>arhat</s> ascetics, // SvayambhuP_1.85 //
he bowed to all of them and to <s>Upagupta</s> with the eight limbs, with joy;
then, having honored that <s>guru</s> <s>arhat</s> with great zeal and according to proper rites, // SvayambhuP_1.86 //
and having bowed, he took his seat to hear the <s>dharma</s>;

children.text: tathā tatmantriṇaḥ sarve sāmātyasacivo janāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.87 //
children.translated_text: likewise all his ministers, along with counselors and attendants, // SvayambhuP_1.87 //
having bowed to that <s>arhat</s> ascetic, took their seats on one side;

children.text: tataḥ so 'rhan mahābhijño dṛṣṭvā sarvā samāśritān // SvayambhuP_1.88 //
children.translated_text: then that <s>arhat</s> of great supernatural knowledge, seeing all assembled, // SvayambhuP_1.88 //
taught the true <s>dharma</s>, excellent in the beginning, middle, and end;

children.text: tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve lokāḥ pravodhitāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.89 //
children.translated_text: having drunk that nectar of the true <s>dharma</s>, all the people were awakened, // SvayambhuP_1.89 //
and having understood the special <s>dharma</s>, they desired the vow of <s>saṃbodhi</s> (perfect enlightenment);

children.text: tataḥ so 'pi mahārājaḥ śrutvā taddharmamuttamaṃ // SvayambhuP_1.90 //
children.translated_text: then that great king too, having heard that supreme <s>dharma</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.90 //
wished to practice the conduct for attaining <s>saṃbodhi</s>;

children.text: tataḥ sa nṛpatī rājā sāñjaliḥ samupāśritaḥ // SvayambhuP_1.91 //
children.translated_text: then that king, the lord of men, with joined palms, having approached, // SvayambhuP_1.91 //
bowed to that <s>arhat</s>, that great being, and looking at him, spoke with joy:
"Venerable one, I wish to hear about the vow for attaining <s>saṃbodhi</s>. // SvayambhuP_1.92 //

children.text: kutra puṇyatamaṃ kṣatraṃ yatrāśu sidhyate vrataṃ /
children.translated_text: Where is the most meritorious land where the vow is quickly accomplished?

children.text: tad bhavān samupādiśya sarvāṃllokān prabodhayan // SvayambhuP_1.93 //
children.translated_text: May you, having instructed that, awakening all people, // SvayambhuP_1.93 //

body.translated_text: joining them to the path of <s>bodhi</s>, cause them to practice."

body.text: iti saṃprārthite rājñā śrutvā so 'rhan mahāmatiḥ // SvayambhuP_1.94 //
body.translated_text: Having heard this request of the king, that <s>arhat</s> of great wisdom, // SvayambhuP_1.94 //

children.translated_text: looking at that <s>Aśoka</s>, the protector of the earth, spoke thus:

children.text: sādhu śṛṇu mahārāja yathā me guruṇoditaṃ // SvayambhuP_1.95 //
children.translated_text: "Well said! Listen, O great king, as was told to me by my <s>guru</s>; // SvayambhuP_1.95 //
so I shall tell you, if you desire the vow of <s>bodhi</s> (enlightenment);
the foremost of all lands, O king, in the northern <s>Himālaya</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.96 //

children.text: nepāle iti vikhyāto yatrāśu sidhyate vrataṃ /
children.translated_text: is the one renowned as <s>Nepāla</s>, where the vow is quickly accomplished;
there, moreover, is an exceedingly great holy land, praised by the <s>Buddhas</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.97 //
the abode of the <s>dharmadhātu</s> (essence of reality) of the king of <s>Svayambhū</s> <s>caityas</s>;

children.text: tatra yadyatkṛtaṃ karma tattatsaṃsidhyate dutaṃ // SvayambhuP_1.98 //
children.translated_text: whatever action is performed there, all of that is quickly accomplished. // SvayambhuP_1.98 //
Thus it is frequented by all great beings and by the <s>Jinas</s> as well;

children.text: iti vijñāya rājendra sambodhiṃ yadi vāñchasi // SvayambhuP_1.99 //
children.translated_text: knowing this, O lord of kings, if you desire <s>saṃbodhi</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.99 //
having gone to that <s>caitya</s> as refuge, practice good restraint;
purified by this merit, with auspicious glory and rich in good qualities, // SvayambhuP_1.100 //
you shall become a <s>bodhisattva</s> of great supernatural knowledge, bearing the welfare of all beings;

children.text: tataḥ kramena sambodhiṃ saṃbhāraṃ paripūrayan // SvayambhuP_1.101 //
children.translated_text: then, gradually fulfilling the accumulations for <s>saṃbodhi</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.101 //
free from defilements, an <s>arhat</s>, lord of the world, you shall attain the state of a <s>Saṃbuddha</s>."

children.text: iti tenārhatādiṣṭaṃ niśamya sa nṛpo mudā // SvayambhuP_1.102 //
children.translated_text: Having heard this instruction of the <s>arhat</s>, that king, with joy, // SvayambhuP_1.102 //
bowed to <s>Upagupta</s>, his <s>guru</s>, and asked respectfully thus:
"Venerable one, I wish to hear the sacred story of the arising of <s>Svayambhū</s>. // SvayambhuP_1.103 //
When did it arise by itself? Please instruct about that."

children.text: iti saṃprārthitaṃ rājñā śrutvā so 'rhan yatiḥ surdhīḥ // SvayambhuP_1.104 //
children.translated_text: Having heard this request of the king, that <s>arhat</s>, the wise ascetic, // SvayambhuP_1.104 //
looking at that <s>Aśoka</s>, the protector of the earth, instructed thus:

children.text: sādhu rājan yathādiṣṭaṃ guruṇā me śrutaṃ mayā // SvayambhuP_1.105 //
children.translated_text: "Well said, O king! As was instructed by my <s>guru</s>, as I heard, // SvayambhuP_1.105 //
so I shall narrate; listen to that with concentration.
At that time, that teacher of the world, <s>Śākyamuni</s> <s>Tathāgata</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.106 //
the omniscient one, the king of <s>dharma</s>, the <s>arhat</s>, lord of sages, the guide —

children.text: sa sarvaḥ sāṃdhikaiḥ sārddhaṃ janapadeṣu saṃcaran // SvayambhuP_1.107 //
children.translated_text: he, together with all his followers, wandering through the regions, // SvayambhuP_1.107 //
at one time came there, to <s>Nepāla</s>;
on the western side of <s>Gopuccha</s> mountain, of the glorious <s>Svayambhū</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.108 //
near the <s>caitya</s> called the 'tip of the tail,' in the hermitage of the <s>Sugata</s>,
for the welfare of all beings, shining like a full moon, // SvayambhuP_1.109 //
he resided with his followers to teach the true <s>dharma</s>;

children.text: yadā sa bhagavāñchāstān sattvānāṃ dharmma vṛddhaye // SvayambhuP_1.110 //
children.translated_text: when that <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One), the teacher, for the growth of <s>dharma</s> among beings, // SvayambhuP_1.110 //
took his seat on the assembly throne to teach the true <s>dharma</s>,

children.text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā tatra mañjuśriyaḥ mamāśrame // SvayambhuP_1.111 //
children.translated_text: seeing him, at that time, in the hermitage of <s>Mañjuśrī</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.111 //
in the monastery, the one dwelling there named <s>Cūḍā</s>, a female celibate practitioner,
an <s>arhantī</s> (worthy nun), a virtuous <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> (nun), desiring the qualities of the true <s>dharma</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.112 //
of very serene disposition, pure, clothed in the saffron <s>cīvara</s> (robe),
having gathered divine offerings and ritual items, delighted, // SvayambhuP_1.113 //
quickly came there to drink that nectar of the true <s>dharma</s>;

children.text: tadā tatra mahāsattvā bodhisattvā jinātmajāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.114 //
children.translated_text: at that time, the great beings, <s>bodhisattvas</s>, sons of the <s>Jina</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.114 //
all of them, headed by <s>Maitreya</s>, came to hear that <s>dharma</s>;
<s>arhats</s> and <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks) also, <s>śrāvakas</s> (disciples), celibate practitioners, // SvayambhuP_1.115 //
<s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> (nuns), female celibate practitioners, ascetics and those observing vows as well,
those seated in the refuge of the <s>Triratna</s> (Three Jewels), male and female lay devotees, // SvayambhuP_1.116 //
all devoted to Buddhist worship, came to hear that <s>dharma</s>;
all of them, having arrived, seeing the <s>Saṃbuddha</s> seated on the assembly throne, // SvayambhuP_1.117 //
joyfully approached;

children.text: te sarve 'bhyarcya taṃ nāthaṃ natvā sāñjalayormudā // SvayambhuP_1.118 //
children.translated_text: all of them, having honored that lord and bowed with joined palms in joy, // SvayambhuP_1.118 //
took their seats in that assembly to drink the nectar of the true <s>dharma</s>;

children.text: brahmaśakrādayā devāḥ sarve lokādhipā api // SvayambhuP_1.119 //
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Śakra</s> (Indra) and other <s>devas</s> (gods), all the lords of the worlds as well, // SvayambhuP_1.119 //
planets, stars and their hosts, <s>siddhas</s> (perfected beings), <s>vidyādharas</s> (knowledge-bearers) as well,
<s>sādhyas</s>, <s>rudras</s>, <s>gandharvas</s> (celestial musicians), <s>yakṣas</s>, <s>guhyakas</s> (secret beings), <s>kinnaras</s> (mythical beings), // SvayambhuP_1.120 //
lords of <s>daityas</s> (demons), lords of <s>rākṣasas</s> (night-wanderers), lords of <s>nāgas</s> (serpent beings), and <s>garuḍas</s> as well,

children.text: evamanyepi lokendrāḥ sarve tatra mudāgatāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.121 //
children.translated_text: thus other lords of the worlds too, all came there with joy, // SvayambhuP_1.121 //

children.text: taṃ munīndraṃ samabhyarcya natvā tatra samāśrayan /
children.translated_text: having honored that lord of sages and bowed, they took their seats there;
<s>Hāritī</s>, the <s>yakṣiṇī</s> (female yakṣa spirit), protectress of <s>bodhisattvas</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.122 //
she too, having brought him offerings, took her seat in that assembly;

children.text: atha sa bhagavānañchāstā dṛṣṭvā sarvān samāśritān // SvayambhuP_1.123 //
children.translated_text: then that <s>Bhagavān</s>, the teacher, seeing all assembled, // SvayambhuP_1.123 //
addressing <s>Maitreya</s>, looking at him, instructed thus:
"<s>Maitreya</s>, this lord of the world, <s>Svayambhū</s>, the shrine of the <s>Jina</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.124 //
the <s>dharmadhātu</s> (essence of reality), the abode of the <s>Triratna</s> — behold it with reverence;

children.text: bhajadhvaṃ śraddhayā nityaṃ gatvātra śaraṇaṃ mudā // SvayambhuP_1.125 //
children.translated_text: worship it always with faith, having taken refuge here with joy; // SvayambhuP_1.125 //
having undertaken the vow of <s>bodhicaryā</s>, wander for the welfare of the world;

children.text: śraddhayā ye bhajantyatra śaraṇaṃ samupāśritāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.126 //
children.translated_text: those who with faith worship here, having taken refuge, // SvayambhuP_1.126 //
having undertaken the vow of <s>bodhicaryā</s>, wander for the welfare of the world;
all of them, freed from sin, with the three spheres completely purified, // SvayambhuP_1.127 //
shall become <s>bodhisattvas</s> of great supernatural knowledge, repositories of good qualities,
endowed with auspicious glory and happiness, abiding in the four <s>brahmavihāras</s> (divine abodes), // SvayambhuP_1.128 //
devoted to the welfare of all beings, practitioners of the vow of <s>saṃbodhi</s>;

children.text: na kvāpi durgatiṃyāyuḥ sadā sadgatisaṃbhavāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.129 //
children.translated_text: they shall never go to a bad destiny, always born in good destinies, // SvayambhuP_1.129 //
zealous in worshipping the <s>Triratna</s>, striving in the practice of the true <s>dharma</s>;

children.text: tataḥ pravrajyā saṃbuddhaśāsane śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.130 //
children.translated_text: then, having gone forth into the teaching of the <s>Saṃbuddha</s> as refuge, // SvayambhuP_1.130 //
having undertaken the vow of celibate conduct, they shall practice with concentration;
then, with purified souls, free from defilements, with senses conquered, // SvayambhuP_1.131 //
having attained the threefold <s>bodhi</s>, they shall reach the state of a <s>Saṃbuddha</s>;

children.text: evaṃ vijñāya ye martyā vāñchanti saugataṃ padaṃ // SvayambhuP_1.132 //
children.translated_text: thus, those mortals who, knowing this, desire the state of the <s>Sugata</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.132 //
let them always worship right here, having taken refuge with faith."

children.text: ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa niśamya te sabhāśritāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.133 //
children.translated_text: Having heard this instruction of the lord of sages, those assembled, // SvayambhuP_1.133 //
all the people, rejoicing, wished to worship likewise;

children.text: maitreyaḥ sa tato dhīmān bodhisattva hi moditaḥ // SvayambhuP_1.134 //
children.translated_text: <s>Maitreya</s>, the wise one, that <s>bodhisattva</s>, delighted, // SvayambhuP_1.134 //
rising up, approached before the lord of sages;
lifting up his upper robe, having bowed to that lord of sages, // SvayambhuP_1.135 //
kneeling on the ground, with joined palms, he spoke thus:
"O <s>Bhagavān</s>, lord, omniscient one, abode of the <s>Jina</s> of the <s>dharmadhātu</s>, // SvayambhuP_1.136 //
when did this arise by itself? Please instruct about that."

children.text: iti saṃprārthite tena maitreyeṇa mahātmanā // SvayambhuP_1.137 //
children.translated_text: Thus being requested by <s>Maitreya</s>, the great soul, // SvayambhuP_1.137 //
looking at the <s>Bhagavān</s> of great wisdom, he instructed thus:

children.text: sādhu śṛṇu samādhāya maitreyo 'sya svayambhūvaḥ // SvayambhuP_1.138 //
children.translated_text: "Well said! Listen with concentration, O <s>Maitreya</s>, about this <s>Svayambhū</s>; // SvayambhuP_1.138 //
I shall tell the story of its arising, for the awakening of all the worlds.

children.text: purāsmin bhadrakalpe 'bhūd vipaśvī nāma sarvavit // SvayambhuP_1.139 //
children.translated_text: In ancient times, in this <s>Bhadrakalpa</s> (Fortunate Aeon), there was one named <s>Vipaśvī</s>, the all-knowing, // SvayambhuP_1.139 //
the teacher of the world, the lord of sages, the <s>arhat</s>, the king of <s>dharma</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>;

children.text: aśīti varṣa sāhasra paramāyūṃṣi yadā nṛṇāṃ // SvayambhuP_1.140 //
children.translated_text: when the maximum lifespan of humans was eighty thousand years, // SvayambhuP_1.140 //
at that time, I was a <s>bodhisattva</s> named <s>Satyadharma</s>, it is said.

children.text: yadā sa bhagavāñchāstā vandhumatyāḥ puro 'ntike // SvayambhuP_1.141 //
children.translated_text: When that blessed teacher, near the city of <s>Vandumatī</s>,
taught the <s>Dharma</s> in the monastery and dwelt with his assembly,
then I, having worshipped that lord of the world, attended upon him.
At that time, there was a lake of seven <s>kośas</s> in extent and breadth,

children.text: tadanuśāsanāṃ dhṛtvā prācaraṃ bodhi samvaraṃ // SvayambhuP_1.143 //
children.translated_text: and having upheld his instruction, I practiced the <s>Bodhi</s> vow (<s>saṃvara</s>).
Endowed with the eight qualities, that reservoir was surrounded by mountains,

children.text: padmotpalādi saugandhi nānā puṣpa praśobhitaḥ // SvayambhuP_1.144 //
children.translated_text: adorned with various fragrant flowers such as lotuses and <s>utpalas</s>.
It was decorated with birds headed by swans, cranes, and geese,
with trees growing on the banks that blossomed in all seasons,
and was surrounded on all sides by fruit-bearing and medicinal trees.
For aquatic creatures headed by fish, turtles, and frogs,
it was an unfathomable abode, the dwelling place of the chief of all <s>Nāgas</s>.
There the great sovereign of all serpents named <s>Karkoṭaka</s> resided.

children.text: evaṃ tadā mahā tīrthaḥ puṇyāmṛtāśrayo vabhau /
children.translated_text: Thus at that time, that great <s>tīrtha</s> (sacred site), a refuge of holy nectar, shone forth.
Always the gods, delighted with the true <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Apsarases</s>,

children.text: snātvā saṃkrīḍamānāḥ satsaukhyaṃ bhuktvā divaṃ yayuḥ /
children.translated_text: having bathed and sported there, enjoying supreme bliss, went to heaven.
Likewise all the great sages beginning with <s>Brahmā</s>, the ascetics,

children.text: snāna saṃdhyādikaṃ karmma kṛtvā saṃsevire sadā /
children.translated_text: having performed bathing, <s>sandhyā</s> (twilight worship) and other rites, always served there.

children.text: evaṃ lokādhipāścāpi snātvātra sarvadā mudā // SvayambhuP_1.150 //
children.translated_text: Thus the lords of the worlds also, having always bathed there with joy,
worshipping in their respective lineages, served with great enthusiasm.
Thus other people too, observers of vows and <s>brahmacārins</s> (celibate students),

children.text: snātvātra saṃvaraṃ dhṛtvāḥ pūtātmāno divaṃ yayuḥ /
children.translated_text: having bathed there and taken the vow (<s>saṃvara</s>), purified in soul, went to heaven.
Likewise many <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, joyfully performing bathing, charity, and vows,
having become pure in soul there, practiced conduct for the welfare of the world.

children.text: evaṃ sarve munīndraiśca snāna vratādi bījaṃphalaṃ // SvayambhuP_1.153 //
children.translated_text: Thus by all the great sages, the seed and fruit of bathing and vows,
most meritorious and supreme, was proclaimed as a means to <s>Bodhi</s> (enlightenment).

children.text: yatra snātvā triratnānāṃ śaraṇe samupāśritāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.154 //
children.translated_text: Those who, having bathed there, took refuge in the Three Jewels (<s>Triratna</s>),
and having taken the vow of <s>Bodhicaryā</s> (enlightened conduct), practiced for the welfare of the world—
they quickly became pure in soul, endowed with auspicious glory and true virtues,
<s>Bodhisattvas</s>, great beings, sons of the <s>Sugata</s> (the Well-Gone One).
Some, with their afflictions (<s>kleśa</s>) removed, desireless toward the cycle of existence,
having attained the enlightenment of a <s>Śrāvaka</s>, became <s>brahmacārins</s>.
And some, pure in soul, detached from <s>saṃsāra</s>,
having attained <s>Pratyekabuddha</s> enlightenment, reached supreme <s>nirvṛti</s> (liberation).

children.text: kecit saṃbodhicittaṃ ca prāpya saddharmalālasāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.158 //
children.translated_text: Some, having obtained the mind of perfect enlightenment (<s>saṃbodhicitta</s>), devoted to the true <s>Dharma</s>,
having taken the vow of <s>Bodhicaryā</s>, practiced for the welfare of the world.
Some, having enjoyed divine sensual pleasures,
attached to the virtues of the true <s>Dharma</s>, always practiced what is auspicious.

children.text: kecit sarve mahīpālāḥ sunīti dharmacāriṇaḥ // SvayambhuP_1.160 //
children.translated_text: Some, all being kings, righteous in their conduct and governance,
having performed deeds for the benefit of beings, at last went to the abode of the <s>Jina</s> (Victorious One).

children.text: ahamapi tadā tatra snātvācaraṃ vrataṃ sadā // SvayambhuP_1.171 //
children.translated_text: I too, at that time, having bathed there, always practiced the vow.
With a soul purified by that merit, I swiftly attained perfect enlightenment (<s>saṃbodhi</s>).

children.text: yaiścāpyasya jalaṃ pītaṃ te 'pi nirmuktapātakāḥ // SvayambhuP_1.162 //
children.translated_text: And those who drank the water of this place, they too were freed from sins,
purified in disposition, virtuous, they became partakers of <s>Bodhi</s>.
Thus this great <s>tīrtha</s> was by all the lords of sages
consecrated and praised on this earth even to this day.

children.text: tatra paścāt svayaṃ dharmadhāturutpatsyate dhruvaṃ // SvayambhuP_1.164 //
children.translated_text: There, afterward, the <s>Dharmadhātu</s> (essence of <s>Dharma</s>) will certainly arise of its own accord.
Having thus instructed, that lord of sages further commanded thus:

children.text: tadā tatra samupanne dharmadhātau jinālaye // SvayambhuP_1.165 //
children.translated_text: "When the <s>Dharmadhātu</s>, the abode of the <s>Jina</s>, arises there,
free from calamity and with auspicious enthusiasm, it shall prevail forever.

children.text: sarve lokāśca taṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmadhātuṃ svayambhūvaṃ // SvayambhuP_1.166 //
children.translated_text: All the people, having seen that <s>Dharmadhātu</s>, the self-existent (<s>Svayambhū</s>),
going to it for refuge with faith, shall always renounce worldly life.
All those people, touched by that merit, with auspicious faculties,
having enjoyed auspicious glory and true happiness, shall at last go to the abode of the <s>Jina</s>."
This instruction given by the lord of sages, <s>Vipaśvin</s>, was heard.
All the people assembled in the gathering were delighted and awakened.

children.text: iti vipaśvinā śāstā samādiṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ mayā // SvayambhuP_1.169 //
children.translated_text: "Thus was the instruction given by the teacher <s>Vipaśvin</s> heard by me,
and it has been told for your awakening; may you be enlightened."
Hearing this instruction given by the lord of sages <s>Śrīghana</s>,

body.translated_text: all including <s>Maitreya</s> and the assembled people were well pleased.

body.text: iti svayambhūdharmadhātu samutpatti nidānakathā prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ /
body.translated_text: Thus ends the first chapter, the narrative of the origin of the <s>Svayambhū Dharmadhātu</s>.
Second chapter, named 'Description of the Fruits of Worship.'

children.text: atha dhīmān mahāsattvo maitreyaḥ sa jinātmajaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then the wise great being <s>Maitreya</s>, that son of the <s>Jina</s>,
having bowed again to the Blessed One, with palms joined, spoke thus:
"O Blessed One, I wish to hear the sacred narrative of the origin of <s>Svayambhū</s>;
may you tell it for the awakening of the people."
Thus entreated by <s>Maitreya</s>, that wise one,
the Blessed One, looking upon those assembled people, instructed thus:
"Well done, <s>Maitreya</s>! All you assembled people, with reverence,
listen, I shall proclaim the sacred narrative of the origin of <s>Svayambhū</s>.
When the lord of sages <s>Vipaśvin</s> had passed into <s>nirvṛti</s> (final liberation),
after a long interval of time, there arose again a teacher of the world.
<s>Śikhin</s> by name, lord of sages, <s>Arhat</s>, king of <s>Dharma</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>,
omniscient, <s>Sugata</s>, lord of all knowledge, the guide (<s>Vināyaka</s>).
At that time, the lifespan of noble people was seventy thousand years.

children.text: ahaṃ kṣemaṃkaro nāma bodhisattvo bhavaṃ kila // SvayambhuP_2.7 //
children.translated_text: I was then a <s>Bodhisattva</s> named <s>Kṣemaṃkara</s>.
When that blessed teacher <s>Śikhin</s>, the lord of <s>Dharma</s>, the <s>Jina</s>,
dwelt at the Buddhist monastery near the city called <s>Aruṇa</s>,
then all the great beings, <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, sons of the <s>Jina</s>,
attended upon and served that teacher <s>Śikhin</s>.
I too likewise, of that <s>Śikhin</s>, the guru of the three worlds,
having approached his refuge, served him always with joy.

children.text: tatraika samaye so 'rhan bhagavān sarvavicchikhī // SvayambhuP_2.10 //
children.translated_text: Once upon a time, that <s>Arhat</s>, the Blessed One, the omniscient <s>Śikhin</s>,
sat upon the assembly seat to teach the true <s>Dharma</s>.

children.text: tadvīkṣya bhikṣavaḥ sarve śrāvakā brahmacāriṇaḥ // SvayambhuP_2.11 //
children.translated_text: Seeing that, all the monks (<s>bhikṣus</s>), the <s>Śrāvakas</s>, the <s>brahmacārins</s>,
the nuns (<s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>), all the observers of vows, the lay men (<s>upāsakas</s>) and lay women (<s>upāsikās</s>),

children.text: tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ samupāgatya taṃ muniṃ // SvayambhuP_2.12 //
children.translated_text: having come near that sage to drink the nectar of the true <s>Dharma</s>,
bowing with joined palms, having circumambulated, took their seats.

children.text: tadā brahmāmarendrādi tridaśāḥ sarve āgatāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.13 //
children.translated_text: Then <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Indra</s> of the immortals, and all the gods arrived,
and all the lords of the worlds also came to hear the <s>Dharma</s>.
<s>Siddhas</s>, <s>Vidyādharas</s>, <s>Sādhyas</s>, <s>Yakṣas</s>, <s>Gandharvas</s>, <s>Kinnaras</s>,
<s>Garuḍas</s>, lords of <s>Rākṣasas</s>, <s>Daityas</s>, and chiefs of <s>Nāgas</s> as well,
sages and <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, and also <s>Tīrthikas</s> (sectarian ascetics) and ascetics,
renunciants and <s>Yogins</s>, <s>Nirgranthas</s> (Jain monks) and <s>Digambaras</s> (sky-clad ones),

children.text: rājāno kṣatriyā vaiśyā amātyā mantriṇo janāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.16 //
children.translated_text: kings, <s>Kṣatriyas</s>, <s>Vaiśyas</s>, ministers, counselors, and people,
artisans, merchants, caravan leaders, and other great people,
townspeople, countryfolk, villagers, and also residents of other lands—
all came with delight to drink the nectar of the true <s>Dharma</s>.

children.text: tatra te samupāgatya samīkṣya taṃ munīśvaraṃ // SvayambhuP_2.18 //
children.translated_text: Having arrived there and beholding that lord of sages,
they worshipped him in proper order and performed circumambulation.

children.text: kṛtvāñjali puṭo natvā parivṛtya samantataḥ // SvayambhuP_2.19 //
children.translated_text: Making the <s>añjali</s> (gesture of reverence), bowing, surrounding him on all sides,
placing him before them and gazing up at him, they reverently took their seats.

children.text: tān sarvān samupāsīnāṃ dṛṣṭvā sa bhagavāñchikhī // SvayambhuP_2.20 //
children.translated_text: Seeing all of them seated, the Blessed One <s>Śikhin</s>
taught the true <s>Dharma</s>, excellent in the beginning, middle, and end.

children.text: tatsaddharmāmṛtaṃ pītvā sarve lokāḥ pravodhitāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.21 //
children.translated_text: Having drunk that nectar of the true <s>Dharma</s>, all the people were awakened,
and devoted to the practice of the true <s>Dharma</s>, they became partakers of <s>Bodhi</s>.

children.text: tasminneva samaye tatra puṇyajalāśraye hrade // SvayambhuP_2.22 //
children.translated_text: At that very time, in that lake, the meritorious sacred reservoir,
a great jeweled stalk with brilliant diamond pistils,
a divine lotus-king made of five jewels with its pericarp,
a great lotus with a thousand petals appeared.
In the central circle of the pericarp of that jeweled lotus,
the <s>Dharmadhātu</s>, the abode of the <s>Jina</s>, arose self-existently (<s>svayambhū</s>).
One cubit in measure, radiant with brilliant pure jewels,
the foundation of the glory of perfect enlightenment (<s>saṃbodhi</s>), adorned with all auspicious marks,
luminous in form, eldest of the world, the abode of the five <s>Tathāgatas</s>,
lord of the world, venerated by the world, worshipped by the world, master of the world,
without beginning or end, undecaying, venerable, bearing all auspicious purposes,
foremost in the form of <s>Samantabhadra</s>, the supreme bearer of the jewel of true <s>Dharma</s>,
lord of the true virtues of the three worlds, bestower of the fruit of the four goals (<s>caturvarga</s>).

body.translated_text: When that <s>caitya</s> (shrine) arose, the earth with its mountains trembled.

children.translated_text: Divine fragrant flowers rained down from the abode of the gods.

children.text: suradundubhayo neduḥ diśaḥ sarvāḥ prasedire // SvayambhuP_2.30 //
children.translated_text: The divine drums sounded; all the directions became serene.
The fires blazed auspiciously turning clockwise, with auspicious radiance.

children.text: suśītalāḥ sugandhyādyā dhīraṃ vavuḥ samīraṇāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.31 //
children.translated_text: Cool, fragrant, and gentle breezes blew softly.
The clouds, rumbling with deep sounds, rained down celestial waters.
The planets, stars, and the moon shone with brilliant splendor.
Sounds of praise, auspicious songs resounded in the sky.
Everywhere auspiciousness and great celebration prevailed without interruption,
prosperity, the arising of glorious virtues, the accomplishment of auspicious true <s>Dharma</s>,
freedom from calamity and auspicious conduct spread in all directions.
Seeing that self-arisen <s>Dharmadhātu</s>, the abode of the <s>Jina</s>,
all beings beginning with <s>Īśa</s> (the Lord), those dwelling in the formless realms (<s>Ārūpya</s>),
though absorbed in the great bliss of yogic meditation, abandoned their festivities,
and came to worship that self-existent lord (<s>Svayambhū Īśāna</s>).
Likewise all sages beginning with <s>Brahmā</s>, the <s>brahmacārins</s>,

children.text: evaṃ svayambhuvaṃ draṣṭuṃ muditā samupācaran // SvayambhuP_2.37 //
children.translated_text: joyfully came to see that <s>Svayambhū</s>.

children.text: evaṃ śakrādayaḥ sarve tridaśāḥ sāpsaro gaṇāḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus all the gods beginning with <s>Śakra</s> (Indra), together with hosts of <s>Apsarases</s>,

children.text: pūjāṅgāni samādāya draṣṭumenaṃ mudā yayuḥ // SvayambhuP_2.38 //
children.translated_text: taking articles of worship, went with joy to see him.
Likewise <s>Agni</s>, <s>Dharmarāja</s> (<s>Yama</s>), <s>Nairṛta</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Marut</s> (Wind),

children.text: śrīdo bhūtādhipaścaivaṃ sarve lokādhipā api // SvayambhuP_2.39 //
children.translated_text: <s>Śrīda</s> (<s>Kubera</s>), the lord of spirits (<s>Bhūtādhipa</s>)—thus all the lords of the world,
together with their respective retinues, delighted with great enthusiasm,

children.text: evaṃ svayambhuvaṃ caityaṃ saṃdraṣṭuṃ samupāyayuḥ // SvayambhuP_2.40 //
children.translated_text: came to behold that self-existent <s>caitya</s> of <s>Svayambhū</s>.
The great king <s>Dhṛtarāṣṭra</s>, delighted together with the <s>Gandharvas</s>,
came with enthusiasm for singing and playing music to behold him. // SvayambhuP_2.41 //
The great king <s>Viruḍhaka</s>, joyfully accompanied by the <s>Kumbhāṇḍas</s>,
having seen <s>Svayambhū</s>, came joyfully to pay homage. // SvayambhuP_2.42 //
<s>Virūpākṣa</s> too, together with all the <s>Nāga</s> lords, the chiefs of serpents,
bearing offerings of jewel-worship, came to behold him. // SvayambhuP_2.43 //
<s>Kuvera</s>, the king of the <s>Yakṣas</s>, also accompanied by <s>Yakṣiṇīs</s>,
bearing offerings of various goods, came to behold him. // SvayambhuP_2.44 //
<s>Vajrapāṇi</s>, lord of secrets, accompanied by all the <s>Guhyakas</s>,
bearing offerings of divine enjoyments, came to behold him. // SvayambhuP_2.45 //
<s>Druma</s>, the king of the <s>Kinnaras</s>, together with all his followers,
came with enthusiasm and the sound of musical instruments to behold him. // SvayambhuP_2.46 //
Likewise the one named <s>Sarvārthasiddha</s>, lord of all the <s>Vidyādharas</s>,
bearing offerings of divine worship, came to behold him. // SvayambhuP_2.47 //
<s>Garuḍa</s>, the king of birds, together with all the flocks of birds,
came with great enthusiasm and their own splendor and glory to behold him. // SvayambhuP_2.48 //

children.text: evaṃ siddhāśca sādhyāśca vasavaśca grahā api /
children.translated_text: Thus the <s>Siddhas</s>, <s>Sādhyas</s>, <s>Vasus</s>, and <s>Grahas</s> (planets),
all the hosts of stars, and all the assemblies of <s>Apsarases</s> (celestial nymphs) — // SvayambhuP_2.49 //
thus all the lords of the <s>Daityas</s>, together with their respective retinues,
with great prosperity and enthusiasm, hastily approached. // SvayambhuP_2.50 //
Thus all the lords of the worlds, stationed in the ten directions,

children.text: dṛṣṭvā taṃ svayambhūtpannaṃ vandituṃ sahasācaran // SvayambhuP_2.51 //
children.translated_text: having seen that self-arisen one, hastily came to pay homage. // SvayambhuP_2.51 //

children.text: sarve 'pi te samāgatya dṛṣṭvā taṃ jagadīśvaraṃ /
children.translated_text: All of them, having assembled and seen that lord of the world,
with joyful hearts, bowing from afar, approached reverently. // SvayambhuP_2.52 //
Then they all worshipped the lord of the world in due order,

children.text: aṣṭāṃgaiḥ praṇatiṃ kṛtvā prābhajanta samādarāt // SvayambhuP_2.53 //
children.translated_text: and having made prostration with the eight limbs, worshipped him with devotion. // SvayambhuP_2.53 //
Some, having anointed him with divine fragrances, worshipped joyfully;
some with various flowers, some with enchanting incense. // SvayambhuP_2.54 //
Some with garlands of flowers, some with divine robes,
some with rows of lamps, some with <s>āratī</s> (waving of lights). // SvayambhuP_2.55 //
Some with divine ambrosia and enjoyable offerings, some with divine herbs,
some with various divine jewel ornaments and adornments. // SvayambhuP_2.56 //
Some with parasols, banners, flags, fans, and canopies;
some with musical concerts — <s>mṛdaṅgas</s>, <s>murajas</s>, and other drums. // SvayambhuP_2.57 //

children.text: kecit tauryatrikai vaṃśaiḥ śaṃkhaiḥ śṛgaiśca kecana /
children.translated_text: Some with the threefold art of music, flutes, conches, and horns;
and some with <s>kāhāras</s> and with <s>vīṇās</s> and other stringed instruments. // SvayambhuP_2.58 //
With <s>tāla</s> and other solid percussion, <s>bherīs</s>, <s>ānakas</s>, and <s>mardalas</s>,
and likewise with various <s>maḍḍus</s>, <s>ḍiṇḍimas</s>, <s>jharjharas</s>, and the like. // SvayambhuP_2.59 //
Some with dances and songs, some with cries of 'hāhā!';
thus with various kinds of celebration they worshipped that <s>Jina</s> shrine. // SvayambhuP_2.60 //
Some, having made circumambulations, worshipped a thousandfold;
some joyfully with <s>dhāraṇī</s> recitations, <s>vidyā</s> mantras, <s>japa</s> (chanting), <s>stotras</s> (hymns), and the like. // SvayambhuP_2.61 //
Thus all those beings, the twice-born and others, in various ways,
having approached with faith, worshipped that <s>Svayambhū</s>. // SvayambhuP_2.62 //
Hearing that this divine great celebration had been,

children.text: śrutvā sarve sabhālokā vismayaṃ samupāyayuḥ // SvayambhuP_2.63 //
children.translated_text: set in motion, all the assembly was filled with wonder. // SvayambhuP_2.63 //
Observing that, the great being <s>Ratnapāṇi</s>, coming forward,

children.text: śikhinaṃ taṃ muniṃ natvā sāñjalirevamabravīt // SvayambhuP_2.64 //
children.translated_text: bowing to that sage <s>Śikhin</s>, spoke thus with joined palms: // SvayambhuP_2.64 //
"O Blessed One, the entire earth has trembled, and a divine festival

children.text: prasāritaṃ ca kasyedaṃ hetu tat samupādiśa // SvayambhuP_2.65 //
children.translated_text: has been set forth — whose is this, and what is the cause? Please instruct us." // SvayambhuP_2.65 //
Thus entreated by that wise <s>Ratnapāṇi</s>,

children.text: sa śikhi bhagavān paśyan ratnapāṇiṃ tamabravīt // SvayambhuP_2.66 //
children.translated_text: the blessed <s>Śikhin</s>, looking at <s>Ratnapāṇi</s>, spoke to him: // SvayambhuP_2.66 //

children.text: sādhu śṛṇu mahāsattva yat sarvā calitā mahī /
children.translated_text: "Listen well, O great being! As to why the entire earth has shaken

children.text: divyotsāhaiḥ pravṛttaṃ ca taddhetuṃ saṃnigadyate // SvayambhuP_2.67 //
children.translated_text: and divine celebrations have commenced — that cause is now declared: // SvayambhuP_2.67 //
Here in the world of the earth, in the north, in the <s>Himālayas</s>,
there is a lake endowed with the eightfold qualities and blessed waters. // SvayambhuP_2.68 //
There, upon a jewel-made lotus, upon the pericarp of the king of lotuses,
has self-arisen a <s>Jina</s> shrine of the <s>Dharmadhātu</s> (realm of truth). // SvayambhuP_2.69 //
At its arising, the entire earth was made to rejoice,
and everywhere an auspicious celebration commenced in the abode of existence. // SvayambhuP_2.70 //
Seeing that, <s>Maheśāna</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Śakra</s> (Indra), and other immortals,

children.text: grahāstārāśca siddhāśca sādhyā vidyādharā api // SvayambhuP_2.71 //
children.translated_text: the planets, stars, <s>Siddhas</s>, <s>Sādhyas</s>, and <s>Vidyādharas</s> also — // SvayambhuP_2.71 //
and all the great sages, filled with wonder and delight,

children.text: sarve lokādhipāścāpi daityā nāgāḥ khageśvarāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.72 //
children.translated_text: all the lords of the worlds, <s>Daityas</s>, <s>Nāgas</s>, lords of birds, // SvayambhuP_2.72 //
<s>Yakṣas</s>, <s>Kinnaras</s>, <s>Gandharvas</s>, <s>Guhyakas</s>, and <s>Rākṣasas</s> too,

children.text: etatprabhṛtayaḥ sarve samīkṣya taṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ // SvayambhuP_2.73 //
children.translated_text: all these and others, having beheld that <s>Svayambhū</s>, // SvayambhuP_2.73 //
filled with joy, having assembled, worship him with great festivals.
This great celebration of worship has been set in motion. // SvayambhuP_2.74 //
This is the great portent that has arisen for this purpose."

children.text: ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śikhinā saṃnisaṃmya saḥ // SvayambhuP_2.75 //
children.translated_text: Thus instructed by the great sage <s>Śikhin</s>, having reflected, // SvayambhuP_2.75 //
<s>Ratnapāṇi</s>, the great being, filled with wonder and delight,
his lotus-face fully awakened, with greatly joyful heart, // SvayambhuP_2.76 //
bowing again to <s>Śikhin</s>, spoke thus with joined palms:
"O Blessed One, may you know what my mind desires. // SvayambhuP_2.77 //

body.translated_text: Please grant your permission and bestow your grace upon this matter.
I too, O Teacher of the World, wish to worship that <s>Svayambhū</s>, that Lord, // SvayambhuP_2.78 //
approaching with faith, worshipping with great celebration."

body.text: iti saṃprārthite tena śrutvā sa bhagavāñchikhi // SvayambhuP_2.79 //
body.translated_text: Having heard this entreaty, the blessed <s>Śikhin</s> // SvayambhuP_2.79 //
looking at <s>Ratnapāṇi</s>, the great being, instructed him thus:

body.text: kulaputra prayāhi tvaṃ yadyāśu bodhimicchasi // SvayambhuP_2.80 //
body.translated_text: "O son of good family, go forth if you swiftly desire <s>Bodhi</s> (enlightenment)! // SvayambhuP_2.80 //

children.translated_text: Approaching with faith, worship that <s>Jina</s> shrine.

children.text: ye tatra samupāśritya bhajeyuḥ śraddhayā mudā // SvayambhuP_2.81 //
children.translated_text: Those who approach and worship it with faith and joy, // SvayambhuP_2.81 //
they shall swiftly attain <s>Saṃbodhi</s> (complete enlightenment) and reach the state of a <s>Sambuddha</s> (fully awakened one).

children.text: ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa ratnapāṇi niśamya saḥ // SvayambhuP_2.82 //
children.translated_text: Thus instructed by the great sage, <s>Ratnapāṇi</s>, having heard, // SvayambhuP_2.82 //

children.text: sāñjalistaṃ muniṃ natvā muditaḥ prācarat tataḥ /
children.translated_text: bowing to that sage with joined palms, delighted, set forth from there.
Then, together with him, many <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, sons of the <s>Jina</s>, // SvayambhuP_2.83 //
<s>Śrāvakas</s> (hearers), <s>Bhikṣus</s> (monks), <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s> (nuns), and <s>Upāsikās</s> (female lay devotees),
<s>Upāsakas</s> (male lay devotees), the devoted, the observant, those eager for merit, // SvayambhuP_2.84 //
<s>Ṛṣis</s> (seers) and <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, ascetics and <s>Yogins</s> too,
sectarian ascetics, <s>Tāpasas</s> (practitioners of austerities), <s>Nirgranthas</s> (Jain monks), and <s>Brahmacārins</s> (celibate students), // SvayambhuP_2.85 //

children.text: rājānaḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā amātyā mantriṇo janāḥ /
children.translated_text: kings, <s>Kṣatriyas</s>, <s>Vaiśyas</s>, ministers, counselors, and common people,
artisans, merchants, caravan leaders, and other great people, // SvayambhuP_2.86 //
city-dwellers, country-folk, villagers, and inhabitants of other lands,
and thus other beings too, those desiring the virtues of the true <s>Dharma</s> — // SvayambhuP_2.87 //

children.text: sarve tatra mahotsāhaistena sārddha mudā carat /
children.translated_text: all there proceeded joyfully with him in great celebration.

children.text: evaṃ sa ratnapāṇistaiḥ sarvaiḥ lokai samanvitaḥ // SvayambhuP_2.88 //
children.translated_text: Thus <s>Ratnapāṇi</s>, accompanied by all those beings, // SvayambhuP_2.88 //
taking up articles of worship, proceeded joyfully with great celebration.

children.text: evaṃ sa pravarañchrīmān sarvāṃllokān vinodayan // SvayambhuP_2.89 //
children.translated_text: Thus that excellent and glorious one, delighting all beings,
having swiftly arrived there, beheld this <s>Jina</s> shrine. // SvayambhuP_2.89-90 //

children.text: dṛṣṭvainaṃ sa mahāsattvaḥ muditaḥ samupāsaran // SvayambhuP_2.90 //
children.translated_text: Having seen it, that great being, delighted, approached reverently,
and having worshipped it in the prescribed manner, bowing, he worshipped joyfully.

children.text: evaṃ sarve 'pi te lokāḥ sahāyāstasyamaharṣayaḥ // SvayambhuP_2.91 //
children.translated_text: Thus all those beings, his companions, the great sages, // SvayambhuP_2.91 //
having worshipped in the prescribed manner, joyfully worshipped with great celebration.

children.text: evaṃ te sakalā lokā stutvā japtvā ca dhāraṇī // SvayambhuP_2.92 //
children.translated_text: Thus all those beings, having praised and chanted <s>dhāraṇīs</s>, // SvayambhuP_2.92 //
having made eight circumambulations, bowing, worshipped joyfully.
Thus other great beings, <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, sons of the <s>Jina</s>, // SvayambhuP_2.93 //
having come from the ten directions, worshipped this Lord.

children.text: ahamapi tadā tena sahetya ratnapāṇinā // SvayambhuP_2.94 //
children.translated_text: I too, at that time, together with that <s>Ratnapāṇi</s>, // SvayambhuP_2.94 //
approaching with faith, worshipped this Lord.
By the power of that merit, having attained <s>Bodhi</s> (enlightenment) even in the <s>Kali</s> age, // SvayambhuP_2.95 //

body.translated_text: having conquered all the hosts of <s>Māra</s>, I became the lord of the <s>Dharma</s>.

body.text: ye yesya samupāśritya bhajeyuḥ śraddhayā mudā // SvayambhuP_2.96 //
body.translated_text: Those who approach this shrine and worship with faith and joy, // SvayambhuP_2.96 //

body.text: te te sarve 'pi saṃbodhiṃ prāpya syuḥ sugatā drutaṃ //
body.translated_text: all of them, having attained <s>Saṃbodhi</s> (complete enlightenment), shall quickly become <s>Sugatas</s> (well-gone ones).
Thus the exceedingly great merit born of this devotional service, // SvayambhuP_2.97 //

children.translated_text: endowed with the good qualities of auspicious glory, is the means to the knowledge of perfect enlightenment.

children.text: iti sarvai munīndraiśca samākhyātaṃ samantataḥ // SvayambhuP_2.98 //
children.translated_text: Thus has it been declared by all the great sages everywhere. // SvayambhuP_2.98 //
You too, having understood this, worship him with devotion.

children.text: munīndrā api sarve 'sya catuḥsandhyaṃ divāniśaṃ // SvayambhuP_2.99 //
children.translated_text: All the great sages also worship him at the four <s>sandhyās</s> (junctures), day and night, // SvayambhuP_2.99 //

children.text: dṛṣṭvā dhyātvā smṛtiṃ dhṛtvā prābhajantaṃ samādarāt /
children.translated_text: having seen, meditated upon, and held him in mindful remembrance, they worship with devotion.

children.text: bhajanti sāmprataṃ sarve buddhāḥ sarve digāśritāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.100 //
children.translated_text: All the <s>Buddhas</s> presently dwelling in all directions worship him now, // SvayambhuP_2.100 //
and all those yet to come shall also worship him always.

children.text: asya darśanamātreṇa praduṣṭā api pāpinaḥ // SvayambhuP_2.101 //
children.translated_text: By merely beholding him, even the corrupt and sinful ones // SvayambhuP_2.101 //
are quickly freed from their sins and become pure in their faculties.
Then those pure-souled ones, free from afflictions, observing celibacy, // SvayambhuP_2.102 //

body.text: durgati naiva gaccheyuḥ kutrāpi hi kadācana //
body.translated_text: shall never go to a state of misfortune, anywhere, at any time.
Having been born in favorable circumstances, endowed with the refuge of auspicious good qualities, // SvayambhuP_2.103 //

children.translated_text: they shall become <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, great beings, sons of the <s>Sugata</s>.
Then they, having fulfilled the accumulation of <s>Bodhi</s> (enlightenment) in due order, // SvayambhuP_2.104 //
having attained the threefold <s>Bodhi</s>, shall reach the state of <s>Nirvṛti</s> (cessation).

children.text: iti natvā sadāpyasya kṛtvā darśanamādarāt // SvayambhuP_2.105 //
children.translated_text: Thus, having always bowed to him and seen him with devotion, // SvayambhuP_2.105 //
having rejoiced, recollected, meditated upon, and experienced his power always,

children.text: nāmāpi ca samuccārya śraddhayā bodhivāchibhiḥ // SvayambhuP_2.106 //
children.translated_text: and having uttered his name with faith, those who aspire to enlightenment, // SvayambhuP_2.106 //
should always perform devotional service according to their ability with devotion.
Thus instructed by the great sage <s>Śrīghana</s>, it is heard: // SvayambhuP_2.107 //
all the assembly, led by <s>Maitreya</s>, were enlightened.
Saying 'so be it,' rejoicing, with faith having approached // SvayambhuP_2.108 //
the self-arisen <s>Dharmadhātu</s>, they desired to worship.

children.text: atha sarvve sabhālokā dharmmadhātoḥ svayambhuvaḥ // SvayambhuP_2.109 //
children.translated_text: Then all the assembly, regarding the self-arisen <s>Dharmadhātu</s>, // SvayambhuP_2.109 //
desired to hear further about the special fruits of worship.

children.text: tanmatvā sa mahāsattvo maitreyaḥ sugatātmaja // SvayambhuP_2.110 //
children.translated_text: Understanding that, the great being <s>Maitreya</s>, son of the <s>Sugata</s>, // SvayambhuP_2.110 //
entreated the blessed great sage thus with reverence:
"O Blessed One, regarding the detailed special fruits of worshipping him, // SvayambhuP_2.111 //
all these assembly members now wish to hear."
Then the Lord, having taught the special fruits of worship,
is worthy of awakening all those assembled in the court.

children.text: iti saṃprārthitaṃ tena maitreyeṇa niśamya saḥ // SvayambhuP_2.113 //
children.translated_text: Having heard this request made by <s>Maitreya</s>,
the Lord, looking upon those assembled in the court, instructed thus:

children.text: śṛṇudhvaṃ sakalā lokā asya pūjāphalaṃ mahat // SvayambhuP_2.114 //
children.translated_text: "Listen, all people, the great fruit of worship of this one.
I shall explain in detail for the enlightenment of all people.
With the five nectars (<s>pañcāmṛta</s>) together with waters, beautifully pure and splendid,
those who joyfully bathe this <s>dharmadhātu</s> (essence of the Dharma), this abode of the <s>Jina</s>,

children.text: mandākinyāṃ sadā snātvā te viśuddhatrimaṇḍalāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.116 //
children.translated_text: having always bathed in the <s>Mandākinī</s>, they become purified in the three spheres.
Enjoying divine pleasures, they ultimately reach the abode of the <s>Jina</s>.

children.text: saurabhya dravyasaṃyukti yatra caityai svayambhuvi // SvayambhuP_2.117 //
children.translated_text: Where at the self-born <s>caitya</s>, with fragrant substances combined,
delighting the minds of the world, they joyfully offer incense always—

children.text: te sugaṃdhitasaumyāṅgā mānyā devā surairapi // SvayambhuP_2.118 //
children.translated_text: they become fragrant-bodied, gentle, honored by gods and <s>Suras</s> alike.
Glorious, well-endowed, they become like jewels.
With the five fragrances (<s>pañcagandha</s>), joyfully, where at the <s>dharmadhātu</s>, the abode of the <s>Jina</s>,
having anointed and worshipped, taking refuge, they always serve with respect.
Endowed with the seven jewels, they become the abode of auspicious glory and good qualities.
All people, devoted to the welfare of others, become lords of the earth.

children.text: ye cātra munirājendrā vicitra cīvarāmbaraiḥ // SvayambhuP_2.121 //
children.translated_text: And those who, for this king of sages, with various and splendid robes,

body.translated_text: having offered with faith and devotion, worship with respect—
they become adorned with divine-looking silken garments and jeweled ornaments.

children.translated_text: Wise, lords of <s>Dharma</s>, virtuous, they become practitioners of auspicious conduct.

children.text: ye caimaṃ kusumaiḥ sarvvai jalajai sthalajairapi // SvayambhuP_2.123 //
children.translated_text: And those who with all flowers, both aquatic and terrestrial,
having worshipped and taken refuge, serve with delight—
they become endowed with the glory of great kings, surpassing even <s>Śakra</s> in splendor.
Blessed with auspicious prosperity and happiness, they become partakers of <s>Bodhi</s> (enlightenment).
And those who with garlands of flowers, beautifully crafted and charming,
with all flowers in long garlands, having adorned, worship—
they become endowed with glorious prosperity, lovers of <s>Dharma</s>, lords of the gods.
Of good fame, devoted to virtues, fortunate, practitioners of the path to <s>Bodhi</s>.

children.text: ye ca puṣpāṇi sarvāṇi mudātra sugatālaye // SvayambhuP_2.127 //
children.translated_text: And those who with all flowers joyfully at the abode of the <s>Sugata</s> (the Well-Gone One),
having scattered them and worshipped, serve taking refuge—

children.text: te 'pi devādhipā svarge gatā mahyāṃ nṛpādhipāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.128 //
children.translated_text: they too, having become lords of the gods in heaven, and on earth, lords of men,
endowed with great glory and virtues, become partakers of <s>Bodhi</s>.
Lamps kindled with fragrant oil and the like, dispelling darkness—
those who joyfully light them at this <s>dharmadhātu</s>, the abode of the <s>Jina</s>,
they become beautiful of form, radiant, dispellers of darkness through the lamp of knowledge.
Their lotus feet worshipped by kings, they become partakers of <s>Bodhi</s>.
Excellent food, worthy of the gods, endowed with delightful fragrance—
those who offer it here and worship with respect,
they become prosperous lords of men, endowed with the seven jewels.
In heaven too, they become lords of the gods and partakers of <s>Bodhi</s>.
And those who at this place offer divine drink, mixed with gold and fragrance,
having offered and worshipped, they serve with concentration—

children.text: te valiṣṭhā mahīpendrāḥ śrīsamṛddhā nirogiṇaḥ // SvayambhuP_2.134 //
children.translated_text: they become strong, lords of the earth, prosperous in glory, free from disease.
Having gone to heaven as lords of the gods, they become partakers of <s>Bodhi</s>.

children.text: ye cāsmiṃ skandamūlāni bījapatraphalāni ca // SvayambhuP_2.135 //
children.translated_text: And those who at this place offer stems, roots, seeds, leaves, and fruits,
having presented them with faith, they worship taking refuge—

children.text: te prabhuktvā yathākāmaṃ bhogyāni vividhānyapi // SvayambhuP_2.136 //
children.translated_text: they, having enjoyed desired objects of enjoyment of various kinds,
devoted to the practice of the true <s>Dharma</s>, they ultimately reach the abode of the <s>Jina</s>.
And those who at this foundation of the <s>Sugata</s> offer groups of wholesome medicines,
having offered them with faith always, they serve with respect—

children.text: te valiṣṭhā supuṣṭāṅgāḥ saumyendriyā nirāmayāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.138 //
children.translated_text: they become strong, well-nourished of body, gentle of senses, free from illness.
Having enjoyed the happiness of royal glory, they proceed to <s>Sukhāvatī</s> (the Land of Bliss).

children.text: ye cāpyatra jinādhāre dharmmadhātau svayambhuvi // SvayambhuP_2.139 //
children.translated_text: And those who at this foundation of the <s>Jina</s>, the <s>dharmadhātu</s>, the self-born,

body.translated_text: having spread canopies high, serve with respect—

body.text: dhanyāste guṇino vaṃdyāḥ śuddhavaṃśā vicakṣaṇāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.140 //
body.translated_text: blessed are they, virtuous, venerable, of pure lineage, discerning.

children.translated_text: Endowed with the accomplishment of all goals, they ultimately proceed to the abode of the <s>Jina</s>.
And those who at this dwelling of the <s>Sugata</s>, having raised various lofty banners,
with great enthusiasm worship, being celebrated—
becoming streams of auspicious glory, good qualities, and happiness, they become lords of the earth on this world,
and in heaven, lords of the gods, and ultimately they proceed to the abode of the <s>Jina</s>.
Those who with golden, jeweled flower-parasols of various kinds,
having raised them here with great enthusiasm, worship with delight—

children.text: te narendrāḥ surendrāśca chatropamāḥ sadā bhave // SvayambhuP_2.144 //
children.translated_text: they become lords of men and lords of the gods, always like parasols in every existence,
having enjoyed great happiness, they ultimately proceed to the abode of the <s>Jina</s>.

children.text: ye cāsmiṃ sugatāvāse patākāḥ pañcaraṅgikāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.145 //
children.translated_text: And those who at this dwelling of the <s>Sugata</s>, having hung five-colored banners,
celebrate with great festivities—

children.text: te bhūtvātra mahīpālāḥ sadā devādhipā api // SvayambhuP_2.146 //
children.translated_text: they, having become protectors of the earth here and lords of the gods too,
having enjoyed auspicious and true happiness, proceed to the abode of the <s>Jina</s>.
And those who at this place with various musical instruments—drums, <s>muruja</s>, and others,
stringed instruments, flutes, and the like—celebrate with great festivities,
they become the abode of beautiful sounds, divine glory, and excellent virtues.
Having practiced the true <s>Dharma</s>, they go to the abode of the <s>Sugata</s>.
Those who at this abode of the <s>Sugata</s>, with parched rice, unbroken grains, and flowers,
having scattered them with faith and devotion, worship with respect—

children.text: durgatinte na gacchanti saṃjātāḥ saṅgatau sadā // SvayambhuP_2.150 //
children.translated_text: they never go to bad destinies, always born in good company.
Having done what benefits all beings, they proceed to the abode of the <s>Jina</s>.
Those who here joyfully offer relics, precious substances, jewels, and gifts,
having offered them with faith, they always worship with respect—
enjoying divine glory and happiness, the abode of auspicious glory and good qualities,
having done what benefits all beings, they proceed to the abode of the <s>Jina</s>.

children.text: ye cāpi stutibhistathyairenaṃ buddhālayaṃ mudā // SvayambhuP_2.153 //
children.translated_text: And those who with truthful hymns of praise joyfully at this abode of the <s>Buddha</s>,
with verses and prose compositions, having praised, worship with respect—
they become endowed with abundant jewels, skilled in all sciences.
Having been kings and lords of heaven, they ultimately go to the state of a <s>Sugata</s>.
Those who with faith approach this lord of the world, the self-born, as refuge,
having bowed with the eight limbs (<s>aṣṭāṅga</s> prostration), pleased, worship with respect—
they become endowed with the seven jewels, lords of men, of great supernatural power.
Devoted to the practice of the true <s>Dharma</s>, they become practitioners of the path to <s>Bodhi</s>.
And those who around this king of <s>caityas</s> perform circumambulation many times,
having meditated and recollected, uttering the name, worship—
they become rememberers of past lives, long-lived, wise, of golden complexion,
venerable, worshipful, and honored, they become practitioners of the path to <s>Bodhi</s>.
And those who, having purified with pure ash-washings all around,
having worshipped with great enthusiasm, serve this lord—
freed from the burning of grief and affliction, long-lived,

children.text: nīrogāḥ sukhino devā bhaveyu bhūmipāśca te /
children.translated_text: healthy, happy, they become gods and also lords of the earth.

children.text: ye ca nirmālyamākṛṣya śodhayitvātra sarvataḥ // SvayambhuP_2.161 //
children.translated_text: And those who, having removed the old offerings and cleaned everything here,
taking on the labor, serve with minds devoted to the <s>Sambuddha</s> (Fully Awakened One)—
freed from affliction and grief, beautiful to behold, of auspicious senses,
glorious, lotus-faced, they become practitioners of the path to <s>Bodhi</s>.

children.text: jīrṇe śīrṇe vibhagne 'smin pratisaṃskṛtya ye mudā // SvayambhuP_2.163 //
children.translated_text: When this place becomes old, decayed, or broken, those who joyfully restore it,
having re-established it with great enthusiasm, worship with respect—
they become endowed with all prosperity, nourished of senses, free from illness.
Lovers of <s>Dharma</s>, of auspicious conduct, they become practitioners of the path to <s>Bodhi</s>.

children.text: jalpitvā yasya mantrāṇi dhāraṇīśca samāhitāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.165 //
children.translated_text: Those who, having recited its <s>mantras</s> and <s>dhāraṇīs</s> with concentration,

children.text: dhyātvā smṛtvā samuccārya nāmāpi prabhajanti ca /
children.translated_text: having meditated, remembered, uttered even the name, worship—
they too, all great beings, purified in the three spheres,
the foundation of auspicious glory and good qualities, become practitioners of the path to <s>Bodhi</s>.
Thus, the great merit at this abode of the lord of <s>Dharma</s>,
born from faith and worship—so it was taught by the lord of sages.
By me, only a condensed summary of this merit is now told;
to expound it fully and in detail here is not possible.
Thus, having understood the great fruit of honor and worship of this one,

children.text: śraddhayā śaraṇaṃ gatvā kartavyaṃ bhajanaṃ sadā /
children.translated_text: having gone to it as refuge with faith, one should always perform worship.
Those who, having gone to this one as refuge with faith, having taken shelter,
with a supremely clear disposition and devotion, worship with minds set on <s>Bodhi</s>—

children.text: na te gacchanti kutrāpi durgatiṃ ca kadācana // SvayambhuP_2.171 //
children.translated_text: they never go anywhere to a bad destiny, not ever.
Born always in good destinies, they become practitioners of the path to <s>Bodhi</s>.

children.text: sadā te sukule jātā bodhisattvā vicakṣaṇāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.172 //
children.translated_text: Always born in good families, they are discerning <s>Bodhisattvas</s>,
benefiting all beings, they should practice generosity and vows until existence ends.
Then, having fulfilled the accumulations for <s>Bodhi</s> in proper order,
having attained the threefold <s>Bodhi</s>, they reach the state of <s>Nirvṛti</s> (liberation).

children.text: na hicitta prasādaspa svalpābhavati dakṣiṇā // SvayambhuP_2.174 //
children.translated_text: Indeed, the offering from a mind of faith is never small

body.translated_text: toward the <s>Tathāgatas</s>, the true <s>Dharma</s>, and the disciples of the fully awakened.

body.text: evaṃ hyacintyāḥ saṃbuddhāḥ buddha dharmāśca nirmalāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.175 //
body.translated_text: Thus, inconceivable are the fully awakened <s>Buddhas</s>, and the <s>Buddha-Dharma</s> is pure.

children.translated_text: Inconceivable indeed is the ripening and great fruit for those who are faithful.

children.text: evaṃ matvā triratneṣu bhaktipūjā phalaṃ mahat // SvayambhuP_2.176 //
children.translated_text: Thus, understanding the great fruit of devotion and worship toward the Three Jewels (<s>Triratna</s>),
one should always perform devotion here at this <s>dharmadhātu</s>, the abode of the <s>Jina</s>.

children.text: ityādiṣṭaṃ munīndrena śrutvā sarve samāśritāḥ // SvayambhuP_2.177 //
children.translated_text: Having heard this instruction given by the lord of sages, all those who had taken refuge,
the people, acknowledging 'so be it,' were delighted and awakened.

children.text: iti me guruṇādiṣṭaṃ śrutamayā tathocyate // SvayambhuP_2.178 //
children.translated_text: Thus what was taught by my <s>Guru</s>, I heard and so it is told;

children.text: tvamapyevaṃ sadā rājan bhaja tatra jinālaye /
children.translated_text: you too, O King, should always worship there at the abode of the <s>Jina</s>.

children.text: tatpuṇyena te bhadraṃ nirutpātaṃ sadābhavet // SvayambhuP_2.179 //
children.translated_text: By that merit, may your well-being be always free from calamity,

children.text: bodhicitta rasaṃ ca saṃprāpya bodhisattvo bhaverapi /
children.translated_text: and having attained the essence of <s>Bodhicitta</s> (the mind of enlightenment), may you become a <s>Bodhisattva</s>.

children.text: tataḥ sambodhi saṃbhāraṃ pūrayitvā tathākramaṃ // SvayambhuP_2.180 //
children.translated_text: Then, having fulfilled the accumulations for perfect awakening (<s>Sambodhi</s>) in proper order,
